title: FC 320: Laundry Carts
officialText:
320.1 Laundry carts with a capacity of 1 cubic yard or more.

Laundry carts with an individual capacity of 200 gallons (1 cubic yard or 0.76 m 3 ) or more used for laundry purposes shall be constructed of noncombustible materials or of materials having a peak rate of heat release not exceeding 300 kW/m 2 at an incident heat flux of 50 kW/m 2 when tested in a horizontal orientation in accordance with ASTM E 1354, and shall be listed and labeled as such.
